dialogues.speaker: Ancient Carvings
dialogues.text: "...its soul, and Starsilver its bones. But the one who could wield it, the ice-breaking outlander, Imunlau..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Carvings
dialogues.text: "...attempted to heal the leylines, but the tree had already withered. After burying the princess..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Carvings
dialogues.text: "...without result or reply, Varuch proceeded on to the summit..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Carvings
dialogues.text: "...snow whipped across the skies. The pillar that fell from the heavens was riven in three..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Carvings
dialogues.text: "...far from snow and strife, and came upon this verdant paradise. A monument was laid down in this place, and it was named Sal Vind..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Carvings
dialogues.text: "...dreamed of the black dragon that blotted out the sun, and knew it to be an omen of doom. That same month, the outlander..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Carvings
dialogues.text: "...guided to where the pale white tree stood. That month, the underground waterway..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Carvings
dialogues.text: "...ended. There is no more need for records. Yet I regret nothing more than having been unable to watch her finish the fresco within that great hall..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... This is really tiring. Activating this many tablets should do it, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Come on, {NICKNAME}, let's check out that place with the super huge door again!
